leadStory: As of Wednesday morning, Rio Ngumoha, on for Bukayo Saka after seventy-one minutes of England's 2-0 win over Czechia in Prague, became at eighteen years and thirty-one days the third-youngest player to appear for England in a competitive match (Sports Mole), on the right flank Cody Gakpo's ankle has emptied before Manchester City at Anfield on 11 October, eleven days away.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is an England cameo in Prague, not a Liverpool still, and STEP 7.5 cannot run from the cloud pass. Antigravity should take no action.
